artist.zh: 约瑟夫·西弗雷德·迪普莱西

medium.en: Oil on canvas, oval, 72.4 × 58.1 cm, in a carved and gilded frame
medium.zh: 布面油画，椭圆形，72.4 × 58.1 厘米，配雕花描金画框

basis.en: A public-domain painting released by The Metropolitan Museum of Art under its Open Access policy (CC0).
basis.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆依其开放获取政策以 CC0 发布的公有领域画作。

alt.en: Oval portrait of an old man with long grey hair, wearing a red coat with a fur collar, set in a gilded carved frame crowned with a laurel wreath, with the word VIR on a tablet beneath.
alt.zh: 一幅椭圆形肖像：一位留着灰色长发的老人，身穿毛皮领的红色外衣；画框雕花描金，顶上饰有月桂花环，下方的牌子上刻着 VIR 一词。

note.en: Painted in Paris in 1778, when Franklin was seventy-two and serving as the American envoy to France. The frame carries a single Latin word, VIR, 'a man'. It hangs beside the epitaph he wrote fifty years earlier as a printer of twenty-two.
note.zh: 1778 年画于巴黎，当时富兰克林七十二岁，正担任美国驻法国的使节。画框上只刻着一个拉丁词：VIR，“一个人”。它挂在他五十年前、二十二岁还是个印刷工时写下的那篇墓志旁边。
